title: Kubernetes administrator flashcards: for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam
releaseBlockers: the exam runs Kubernetes v1.35 while the docs describe v1.37: check that no card teaches a feature newer than v1.35
description: CKA: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.

glossary.UDP: User Datagram Protocol, a connectionless transport
glossary.SCTP: Stream Control Transmission Protocol, a message-based transport
glossary.CRI: Container Runtime Interface, how the kubelet talks to a container runtime
glossary.OCI: Open Container Initiative, the standards for container images and registries
glossary.CNAME: a DNS record that points one name at another
glossary.AAAA: a DNS record that holds an IPv6 address

sourceShort: the Kubernetes documentation and the CNCF curriculum

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 891 cards against the Kubernetes documentation they quote, word for word as found by the card checker, and checked that nothing newer than Kubernetes v1.35 is taught as v1.35
checks.result: 2 wrong cards (what a plain kubectl apply does with an unknown custom-resource field, and a NetworkPolicy scenario with two right answers) were fixed and rechecked; 7 unsupported claims, 6 ambiguous cards, 4 unclear ones and 22 minor issues were also fixed, and 4 cards that repeated earlier ones were removed.
